lines.text: The LORD will drive out seven nations; do not intermarry with them, or your sons will serve other gods.
Tear down their walls, smash their sacred pillars, cut down their Asherah poles, and burn their idols in the fire.
The LORD chose you as His prized possession because He loved you and kept His oath to your fathers.
The LORD will drive out nations little by little, give you their kings, and none will stand against you.
